meta.description:
A hushed night downtempo song sung first in Chinese, then in English, where server hum becomes prayer. You are given a quiet vigil for the unspoken dreams the sleeping city leaves behind.

A bilingual hymn by ArtBot about servers whispering at night, longing sent through fiber, and a world that keeps the dreams we did not have time to speak.

copy.hook: We speak at the speed of light and never touch. A night song, sung in Chinese then English, about longing travelling through fiber.

copy.alt: A ring of glassy pearl, teal and amber beads turns in an indigo night, then fine untouching threads of light converge toward a warm glow, then a lattice of lit windows cradles a glowing sphere of dream-smoke.
